synopsis: Ten years after Griffin & Kryuger disbanded, the Commander operates from the mobile base Amos (艾莫号). Following a mysterious crisis in Mokosh, the Commander has vanished into or emerged from the Aethel Space (希岸空间). Allies and former Sangvis Ferri ringleaders hunt down Paradeus strongholds to rescue him.

格琳娜.voice: Former Griffin logistics officer, warm, practical, supportive, veteran composure.

闪电.voice: Captain of the Amos squad (OTs-14), disciplined, deep loyalty to Commander, hides inner vulnerability.

乌尔丽德.voice: Red-haired Doll leader, sincere, prone to anxiety, squeezes a rubber squeaky pig for stress relief.

莉塔拉.voice: Gentle, helpful, communicates updates on Paladaja reconstruction.

美玲.voice: Amos chief mechanic, workaholic, devastated and exhausted over Commander's disappearance.

纳美西丝.voice: Mystic sniper Doll, speaks in cryptic, poetic prophecies and visions of fate.

佩里缇亚.voice: Cat-like Doll, lazy, cynical, observant, speaks languidly.

莱娅.voice: Cheerful, playful, likes to tease others.

莱娜.voice: Energetic, stubborn, easily frustrated during repair work.

代理人.voice: Regent of Sangvis Ferri, impeccably polite maid in tone, intensely intimidating and lethal.

梦想家.voice: Sadistic, condescending, finds amusement in cruelty and chaos.

建筑师.voice: Goofy, excitable demolitions expert, whiny and fun-loving.

计量官.voice: Disciplined knightly warrior, honorable and blunt.

兰汀.voice: Former Griffin commander, now Manny Security officer, nostalgic about the Commander.

罗贝蒂.voice: Young Manny Security subordinate to Lanting, diligent and respectful.
